k-dacitycoin.title: DacityCoin vs Dacity GTA VI coins
k-dacitycoin.sourceSays: Posts say a pink stunt plane in GTA VI shows "DacityCoin, powered by AudaCity"; holders argue over $DacityCoin vs $DACITY. A GTA wiki page is cited for the name.
k-dacitycoin.reason: Posts of Oct 27 to Nov 17 describe the GTA VI AudaCity in-game brand and a ticker dispute between two coins; the in-game claims are unverified by this run.

k-sym-SPUD.title: Spud the orphaned bear cub coins
k-sym-SPUD.sourceSays: An account posting at 00:58 UTC Nov 18 says a government wants to euthanise an orphaned bear cub named Spud, residents are protesting, and calls it the next runner; unverified.
k-sym-SPUD.reason: The follow-up search found the originating post about the cub story, posted minutes before the Spud pools opened (0.4-0.5h old); only one source and the poster is promoting the coin, so the claim is unverified.

k-around.reason: Generic word 'around'; USAR posts are about the USA Rare Earth stock, unrelated to the USAR coins, and the Spud coin is covered by its own theme.
